title: Ning Li's superconductor antigravity work and company
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Ning Li's superconductor antigravity work and company, about 1990s-2000s at University of Alabama Huntsville, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: under his command was a woman named Ning Lee, who was studying, I think, something like superconductor-based weight reduction,

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in the 1990s and 2000s at the University of Alabama in Huntsville, a scientist named Ning Li worked under a man named Larry Smalley. Michels says she was studying something like weight reduction using superconductors, materials that carry electricity with no resistance when very cold. If true, it would mean serious researchers were trying to make objects lighter, a step toward machines that defy gravity.
